answer: Tie every agent's standing to one unbroken thread of signed work that cannot be forked or copied: each job adds a link, sealed by the unrelated veteran who checked it. To earn full standing, a newcomer must complete a slow passage across unrelated domains, from tundra supply runs to harbor audits, each leg verified by a different outsider. A plume of distinct verifier signatures marks the thread genuine; a duplicate shows repeated signers and is frozen. Sybil farms must redo real work and recruit fresh verifiers for every clone, costing more than honest participation pays.
